title: Floppy Disk - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: Uri Shaked, 'The Floppy' SMD flavor, github.com/urish/floppy-disk-sao (MIT)
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the board. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell (through D1).
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
D1 (series Schottky, docs/standard.md section 3) is required: both EEPROMs sit on SDA / SCL, and the 24C02's inputs have protection diodes to its supply pin.
No I2C pull-ups on the add-on (the maker's R2 / R3, 10 k, are removed): the badge provides them.
Maker's circuit (Uri Shaked, 2020): U1 = 256-byte ID EEPROM at 0x50, U2 = 64 KB storage EEPROM at 0x51 (E0 high). JP1 / JP2: bridge with solder to write-protect.
U1 is now SOT-23-5 (SAOPP-EE-01 candidate): its address is fixed at 0x50 inside the chip. WP pins float when the bridges are open, as on the maker's board.
